description: Trial010 adds only a smooth ground-normal wheel-load reserve penalty to original trial004, resuming its fixed final checkpoint. Sum exp(-max(F_ground_world_z,0)/(0.20*live_robot_weight)) over two separately ground-filtered wheels, reward weight -1. The force scale is not a minimum-load threshold. Sample the last actual5ms substep at the unchanged50Hz reward clock; no all-substep objective or observation change. Retain original500/10PD, old rewards, last-substep wheel-vz sampling, motor randomization, reference, friction, explicit MuJoCo contact response, clocks and every acceptance gate. Verify live mass/gravity and filtered normal-force GPU telemetry before learning. No forced50:50load, contact equivalence, hardware or statistical robustness claim.
